metadata.name: Riftbound Product Registration
metadata.description: Signs saved riotgames.com accounts into the Riftbound XSSO client and enters them in the Riftbound T1 Signature Edition product-registration drawing (campaign 31, item RB3864-00-00). Browser port of the requests-based riot-entry tool: it drives the real registration page, so it handles the login hCaptcha, email MFA, product + legal consent, and the opt-in confirmation, then writes the entry marker back to the account and logs it to Inventory. Accounts already opted in are recorded without a second submission.

inputs.label: Save folder (optional)
inputs.hint: Names this run's Inventory rows, the same as the native riot-entry tool's --event-name. Entered accounts keep whichever Database folder they are already in.
